models.name: Qwen3.8-27B (iPad Pro + eGPU R9700)
models.full_name: Qwen3.8-27B (iPad Pro driving a Thunderbolt Sapphire R9700 eGPU)
models.why: An iPad Pro over Thunderbolt to a Sapphire R9700 eGPU runs Qwen3.8-27B at Q4 with a 131K context: 31 t/s standard decoding, 109 with MTP and 159 with DFlash2 draft-tree decoding in the LemonSeed Engine, plus ~1,636 t/s prefill on 4K input.
